summary: Pound Boxing Gym is a family-owned Muay Thai gym in Chiang Rai offering group classes, private sessions and optional sparring.

facts.label: Session price
facts.value: Group sessions 200 baht an hour, private sessions 500
facts.quote: Chiang Rai offers Muay Thai Group sessions for 200 baht an hour and 500 for private sessions

facts.label: Sparring
facts.value: Optional sparring on Tuesdays and Fridays at 6pm
facts.quote: Optional Sparring - Tuesdays and Fridays at 6pm

facts.label: Levels
facts.quote: Beginner to advanced training - pad work is personalized to your level.

facts.label: Visa sponsorship
facts.quote: We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time
